findings.issue: The feature set includes billed_amount and allowed_amount, flagged as target-derived fields in the output. For an early-warning model that must operate 'when a claim comes in,' these amount fields likely are not available at claim intake and introduce data leakage. The ROC-AUC of 0.997 is suspiciously high for a model based on clinical/administrative features, indicating the model may rely excessively on post-intake amounts and will not generalize to the intended operational use case.
findings.suggested_change: feature_set: remove billed_amount and allowed_amount from features parameter

summary: Review identifies one material issue: potential data leakage from target-derived amount fields prevents the model from achieving its stated objective of early-warning capability at claim intake time. Model should use only claim-intake-available features (clinical and administrative attributes) to be operationally useful for nurse review flagging.
